messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Billing metering anomaly detected — token-count drift in eu-west-1 ingest path. Paging @micah. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift
micah: on it, pulling dashboards and logs. can someone post recent emit rates and any evidence of duplicate emits?
anya: quick snapshot: emit-rate eu-west-1 09:00-09:10 = ~2800 tokens/min vs 1h avg ~1200. lots of retry bursts from proxy-emitter. sample query: ```SELECT count(*) FROM emits WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'``` shows +130%
leo: logs show `ingest-proxy` retry loop hitting idempotency key mismatch -> duplicates. excerpt: ```WARN 2025-03-22T09:12:03Z proxy Retry failed for emitId=abcd1234 attempts=6 cause=Timeout```
ops-bot: metric snapshot posted: tokens/min baseline=1200 current=2800; overage-flag events=42 in last 15m (billing pipeline)
maria: CS note: a handful of customers have received automated overage flags from the billing pipeline. I'm standing by for list and we should pause noisy flags if mitigation works.
micah: mitigation plan (live): 1) throttle emitter retries at proxy 2) pause kafka replay/backfill for eu-west-1 3) kick reconcile (shadow ledger diff) job 4) prepare customer comms and pause further automated overage actions. assign: @leo throttle, @billing-eng reconcile, @maria CS comms. I'll run handoff to night oncall after initial stabilise.
leo: applying throttle now — API call: `curl -XPOST https://infra/api/proxy/config -d '{"retries":1}'` -> rolling to nodes in eu-west-1
deploybot: rollout patch to ingest-proxy config started (3 nodes)
ops-bot: rollout progress: node-1 OK, node-2 OK, node-3 FAIL -> investigating connectivity error
leo: manual patch applied to node-3, throttle now live across cluster. monitoring for duplicate suppression.
anya: after throttle, emit-rate dropped to ~1450 tokens/min within 3 minutes. new overage flags paused (billing pipeline buffer cleared).
billing-eng: reconcile job started: job_id=run-20250322-1234. computing per-customer delta, will surface customers with >1% delta. ETA ~30m
maria: drafting short customer note: "We're investigating a billing telemetry anomaly that may have generated duplicate usage. We've applied mitigations and will follow up with any adjustments/credits." Ping @CS for review.
sre-oncall: watching the proxy node metrics and kafka consumer lags. no downstream errors observed.
micah: handoff: I'll be handing off to @ryan in 25m after final checks. @ryan you'll inherit monitoring links + reconcile job id. escalate back to me if reconcile shows >5% net delta for customers.
ryan: taking handoff at 09:45 UTC, will monitor for next 12h. I've acknowledged the pager.
maria: CS note sent to impacted cohort (small set) with escalation link. reply template ready for credits if billing-eng confirms duplication.
billing-eng: reconcile finished initial pass: most customers <0.5% delta; 6 customers between 1-3% flagged for follow-up. full report uploaded to runbook.
micah: good containment. next actions: finalize credits for the 6, run postmortem checklist, and add proxy retry threshold to runbook. leaving thread, thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident transitioned -> mitigated (partial). severity=P2. If post-reconcile delta increases, incident will reopen.
